#!/usr/bin/python
from __future__ import print_function
import SocketServer
import socket
import sys
import urlparse

LISTEN = ('0.0.0.0', 3128)
ORIGIN_IP = '10.100.161.11'
ORIGIN_NAMES = set([ORIGIN_IP, 'node2'])
ORIGIN_PORT = 8081
ALLOWED_CLIENT = '10.100.161.11'
MAX_LINE = 65536
MAX_BODY = 10485760

class ProxyHandler(SocketServer.StreamRequestHandler):
    def reply(self, code, reason):
        body = '%d %s\n' % (code, reason)
        self.wfile.write(('HTTP/1.1 %d %s\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n%s' %
                          (code, reason, len(body), body)))

    def handle(self):
        if self.client_address[0] != ALLOWED_CLIENT:
            self.reply(403, 'Forbidden')
            return
        request_line = self.rfile.readline(MAX_LINE)
        if not request_line or len(request_line) >= MAX_LINE:
            self.reply(400, 'Bad Request')
            return
        parts = request_line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) != 3:
            self.reply(400, 'Bad Request')
            return
        method, target, version = parts
        if method.upper() == 'CONNECT':
            self.reply(403, 'CONNECT Forbidden')
            return
        try:
            parsed = urlparse.urlsplit(target)
            port = parsed.port
        except Exception:
            self.reply(400, 'Bad Request')
            return
        if parsed.scheme.lower() != 'http' or not parsed.hostname:
            self.reply(400, 'Absolute HTTP URL Required')
            return
        if parsed.hostname.lower() not in ORIGIN_NAMES or port != ORIGIN_PORT:
            self.reply(403, 'Destination Forbidden')
            return

        headers = []
        content_length = 0
        while True:
            line = self.rfile.readline(MAX_LINE)
            if not line or line in ('\r\n', '\n'):
                break
            if len(line) >= MAX_LINE or ':' not in line:
                self.reply(400, 'Bad Request')
                return
            name, value = line.split(':', 1)
            lname = name.strip().lower()
            if lname == 'content-length':
                try:
                    content_length = int(value.strip())
                except ValueError:
                    self.reply(400, 'Bad Request')
                    return
            if lname not in ('proxy-connection', 'connection', 'keep-alive'):
                headers.append((name.strip(), value.strip()))
        if content_length < 0 or content_length > MAX_BODY:
            self.reply(413, 'Request Entity Too Large')
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length) if content_length else ''
        path = parsed.path or '/'
        if parsed.query:
            path += '?' + parsed.query
        upstream = None
        try:
            upstream = socket.create_connection((ORIGIN_IP, ORIGIN_PORT), 10)
            upstream.sendall('%s %s HTTP/1.0\r\n' % (method, path))
            for name, value in headers:
                if name.lower() == 'host':
                    value = '%s:%d' % (ORIGIN_IP, ORIGIN_PORT)
                upstream.sendall('%s: %s\r\n' % (name, value))
            upstream.sendall('Connection: close\r\n\r\n')
            if body:
                upstream.sendall(body)
            while True:
                data = upstream.recv(65536)
                if not data:
                    break
                self.wfile.write(data)
        except Exception as exc:
            print('upstream error: %s' % exc, file=sys.stderr)
            try:
                self.reply(502, 'Bad Gateway')
            except Exception:
                pass
        finally:
            if upstream is not None:
                upstream.close()

class ProxyServer(SocketServer.ThreadingMixIn, SocketServer.TCPServer):
    allow_reuse_address = True
    daemon_threads = True

ProxyServer(LISTEN, ProxyHandler).serve_forever()
